text:
michelle_user: hi team :wave: signed up a few mins ago, verified email and added card, but my welcome credits didn't show. account: michelle@example.com
elaine_support: sorry to hear! can you DM me the account id or paste the customer_id from console? keeping thread visible so others can help.
michelle_user: acct id: acct_01G7XYZ — card Visa (billing address Spain). completed 3DS and email verify. tried refresh, nothing.
payments-bot: autogrant-check: acct_01G7XYZ result=SKIP reason=[pm_bin_country_mismatch,delayed_3ds] pm_country=ES inferred_country=FR
jordan_ops: hm — pm bin says ES but inferred country from signup IP was FR. michelle_user can you paste the signup IP?
michelle_user: signup IP 51.15.24.8 — i'm on company VPN (hosted in France) but my billing address is Spain. also my email is michelle@forwarder.io which forwards to my real inbox.
samir_eng: looking at autogrant logs — service flagged forwarded email domain and a 3DS callback hit at t+8s, which triggered the fraud path. snippet: ```{ "autogrant_decision": "SKIP", "reasons": ["pm_bin_country_mismatch", "delayed_3ds"] }```
elaine_support: thanks Samir. michelle_user — that explains why autogrant skipped. we can do a manual grant for you now. want us to apply the welcome credit?
michelle_user: yes please, that would be great.
elaine_support: applying manual grant now and adding internal note. won't touch your card. one sec :white_check_mark:
payments-bot: manual-grant: acct_01G7XYZ amount=1000units reason=manual_support_grant id=grant_001A
elaine_support: done — you should see the credits in your dashboard within ~30s. created ticket PAY-4532 to review rules for forwarded-email + VPN signups.
michelle_user: saw it! credits are there now, thanks so much :tada:
samir_eng: follow-ups: recommend we relax strict country-match when email forwarding domains present and allow 3DS callback window up to 10s before triggering review. will push a canary config for this. tagging @jordan_ops to validate logs next week.
jordan_ops: on it — i'll pull a list of recent SKIPs with pm_bin!=inferred_country and forwarder domains and share numbers in PAY-4532.
